Quality Control Across Every Stage.

Material testing, batch documentation and process controls support manufacturing from incoming materials through finished-product review.

Quality Control

In-house testing of raw materials, packaging materials, in-process materials and finished products through established procedures.

Batch Documentation

Controlled records, batch review and data-integrity practices support manufacturing documentation and product traceability.

Process Control

Deviation investigations, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and change control are managed through documented procedures.

Controlled Production

Dedicated production areas, QC and microbiology facilities, and supporting utility systems are integrated into the manufacturing site.

THE KAMADHENU–BRINDAVAN GROUP

Over 32 Years of
Manufacturing Excellence.

BRIPHA is the dedicated pharmaceutical manufacturing arm of the Kamadhenu–Brindavan Group—a diversified industrial conglomerate operating across animal nutrition, pharmaceutical formulations, bio-fertilisers, and polymer packaging. With over three decades of technical expertise, the group pioneered inorganic rock-based DCP in India and stands as the largest contract manufacturer for Virbac in India.

Strategic Conglomerate Affiliation: Ladhani Group (SLMG Beverages)India's largest independent bottling partner for The Coca-Cola Company, anchoring the group's operational resilience, supply chain strength, and institutional governance.

FOUR DIVERSIFIED INDUSTRIAL VERTICALS

Operating Entities & Core Capabilities

Each vertical operates dedicated infrastructure, specialized R&D teams, and independent regulatory certifications under the group umbrella.

VERTICAL // 01Pioneered Rock-Based DCP in India

Animal Nutrition

Over 32 years of formulating specialized feed supplements, mineral nutrition, and veterinary healthcare. Instrumental in shifting the Indian market from bone-based to inorganic rock-based Di-Calcium Phosphate (DCP).

  • •Pioneer in inorganic rock-based DCP technology
  • •Advanced formulations & dedicated animal nutrition R&D
  • •Large-scale continuous manufacturing operations
